content: Overall, our full architecture can be illustrated as in Figure 2 , which consists of an entity linking system (ELS), a sequence-to-sequence with attention mechanism model, and the E2T module. We note that our proposed module can be easily attached to more sophisticated abstractive summarization models BIBREF13 , BIBREF14 that are based on the traditional encoder-decoder framework and consequently can produce better results. The code of the base model and the E2T are available online.
